$comment: FD-VISUAL-01 §3.2.4 asset manifest. Every image or video served by either app must have an entry here; CI fails otherwise (scripts/check-media.mjs, e2e/tests/fd-visual-01-media.spec.ts). 'pages' lists where the asset renders today and is checked against the built sites; 'plannedPages' is the founder-approved placement not yet built. 'focus' is the object-position used when a frame crops the asset. 'text' lists the creative's own type as boxes in 0–1 image coordinates ([x0, y0, x1, y1]); every crop keeps each block whole or crops it out entirely, and a 'keep' block (a disclosure) always stays whole (packages/ui/src/media/crop.ts). 'handlesShown' lists invented social handles drawn in phone frames and whether each has been name-checked.
